mapper.select:
SELECT seq , description, ip, use_flag, create_user_id, created_at, update_user_id, updated_at FROM tb_allowed_ip tai WHERE 1=1
AND tai.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{description}, '%')
AND tai.ip LIKE CONCAT('%', #{ip}, '%')
AND tai.create_user_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{createUserId} , '%')
AND tai.update_user_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{updateUserId} , '%')
ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_allowed_ip ( description, ip, use_flag, create_user_id, update_user_id ) VALUES ( #{description}, #{ip}, #{useFlag}, #{createUserId}, #{updateUserId} )
